100 Years Ago Today, This is What Was Happening ...

On September 5, 1926, the British Empire faced a significant political crisis as Prime Minister Stanley Baldwin headed to the House of Commons to address ongoing tensions with labor unions. Meanwhile, in Germany, the economy struggled under the weight of reparations, fueling rising discontent among the populace.
